concerns: The calendar page lists PARTNER congresses (IUSTI, CILAD, World Congress of Dermatology, ...), not EADV's own; they have no page on eadv.org, so booking_url is the partner site and organiser_url is set so the explorer can look for fees. Venue names are not on the cards (city + country only), so with_venue is 1 of 9 (the Symposium).

EADV's own Congress: /congress/ still shows Vienna 2026 (past), so it is correctly skipped; once the 2027 title is published the same title regex picks it up (needs 'EADV Congress 2027 | City d-d Mon yyyy' or a year in the title).

EADV Symposium 2027 fees: registration page says 2027 information is coming and only shows 2026 rates, so empty pricing is deliberate. Re-check after the Symposium registration opens (the fee table on /symposium/registration/ is plain text lines, EUR, member categories x early/mid/full).

The UEMS diploma exam card is skipped (exam, not an education event); 26 cards include hidden responsive duplicates, deduped by title+start; MAX_FUTURE_DAYS=600 keeps the Rare Skin Diseases congress (April 2028).

Partner descriptions are the partner site's meta description when usable, else a one-line 'Title in City. Dermatology meeting listed on the EADV events calendar'; some partner meta text is shouty or sparse (e.g. the Psoriasis G2C one).

Coverage checklist: multi-day ranges parsed (incl. year-less card); fees via external 'here' links not applicable on cards (partner site stored as organiser_url, not followed); same-site Registration sub-page checked for the Symposium (stale); image fee tables, PDFs, call-for-papers not present on the checked pages.
